attributes.description: The highest-severity scoring actions in range (the top 12 by severity, rarest first within a weight), one row per action and weight, placed by how often each happened. Each row ends with its severity weight (· 45), which the colour repeats: one colour per weight, from blue for 10 to deep red for 50, listed in the key below the chart. Rarest is on the left, so the top-left corner is rare and high-severity: where to look first. A failed action gets its own row, marked (failed) unless its name already says so; a failed Kibana change scores 40 whatever it changed. Hover a point for how many identities did it and when.
attributes.title: [Audit] Rare Event Scatter
